description.en: Artificial Inu (AI) is an ERC-20 community token launched through LONG on Robinhood Chain. Its principal market pairs AI directly with Robinhood's tokenized NVDA Stock Token through an onchain liquidity pool rather than a conventional stablecoin quote. Creator-fee routing from trading activity directs NVDA-denominated fees to a community vault and AI-denominated fees to permanent burns or locked balances. AI is a volatile community token; it does not represent NVIDIA equity, confer shareholder rights, or provide holders with an automatic right to redeem assets from the vault.
